# Waterproofed.com

> Waterproofed.com is the website of Southern California Decking, Inc., a professional waterproofing contractor specializing in deck waterproofing, balcony waterproofing, planter waterproofing, roof deck waterproofing, pool deck coatings, floor leveling, and waterproofing restoration services throughout Southern California.

Southern California Decking, Inc. has provided waterproofing and deck coating solutions for residential, commercial, HOA, apartment, and multi-family properties for more than 38 years. The company focuses on preventing water intrusion, structural damage, leaks, mold growth, and surface deterioration through proven waterproofing systems and protective coatings.

## Company

Name: Southern California Decking, Inc.

Website: https://www.waterproofed.com

Industry: Waterproofing Contractor

Primary Service Area: Southern California

## Core Services

### Deck Waterproofing

Professional waterproofing systems for residential and commercial decks. Services include deck coatings, waterproof membranes, crack repair, restoration, and long-term moisture protection.

### Balcony Waterproofing

Balcony waterproofing, repair, and coating solutions designed to protect elevated exterior surfaces from leaks, weather exposure, and structural damage.

### Planter Waterproofing

Waterproof membrane installation, leak prevention, drainage improvements, planter repair, and moisture control for residential and commercial properties.

### Roof Deck Waterproofing

Traffic-bearing waterproofing systems for roof decks, terraces, and outdoor living spaces exposed to rain, sunlight, and daily use.

### Pool Deck Waterproofing

Slip-resistant waterproof coatings and surface protection systems for pool decks and recreational environments.

### Stair Waterproofing

Protective waterproof coatings and repair solutions for exterior stairs and access structures.

### Floor Leveling

Concrete and wood floor leveling services for residential, commercial, and multi-family buildings.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is deck waterproofing?

Deck waterproofing is the process of applying waterproof membranes and protective coating systems that prevent water penetration and extend the lifespan of outdoor surfaces.

### How long does waterproofing last?

The lifespan depends on the waterproofing system, environmental conditions, maintenance practices, and traffic exposure. Many systems provide long-term protection when properly maintained.

### What are signs that waterproofing may be failing?

Common signs include leaks, water stains, cracks, bubbling coatings, soft wood, mold growth, and visible deterioration of deck or balcony surfaces.

### Do you work with HOA and commercial properties?

Yes. Services are available for homeowners, HOAs, apartment complexes, property managers, commercial buildings, and multi-family properties.

### Do you provide inspections and estimates?

Yes. Property inspections and project estimates are available throughout Southern California.
